method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading of the part title and editorial scope statement, followed by exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier, issue-reference and import comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Model-theory part driver describing the material's incomplete experimental status, its source and exclusions, the work still needed for textbook use, and its four imported chapters.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The model-theory material is incomplete and experimental. It currently adapts Aldo Antonelli's model-theory notes while omitting theories, completeness and compactness because first-order logic already covers them. It needs substantially more introduction, motivation, explanation and exercises for textbook use, and Andy Arana is planning work specifically on this part.
samples.checks: The title, provisional status, sole-source characterization, all three exclusions with their stated reason, the four kinds of needed development, both names and the issue reference are retained.

source_observations: The target reuses the established transparent compound प्रतिमान उपपत्ती and keeps उपपत्ती, संपूर्णता and संहतता distinct.
The four chapter imports, part hook, macros, identifiers and issue number match the frozen source exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
प्रतिमान उपपत्ती remains an expert-reviewable transparent compound rather than a directly attested fixed disciplinary title.
The personal-name transliterations are source-guided and have not been independently attested in Marathi.
No TeX reader build was run for this individual part driver.
